articles.title: Judge Cliff Coleman Announces Resignation Move to Sheriffs Office
articles.excerpt: On June 23, 2026, he announced he would resign effective July 20, 2026 to take a position with the Bell County Sheriff's Office at the request of Sheriff Bill Cooke; he said he expected county officials to appoint Republican runoff winner Michael Tice to the seat (KDH).
